what: Caption box at the bottom left of a photo slot — on hover, the background fill rises from bottom to top (height 0 → 100%) and the caption text rises over it from 120% below the box, .03s late (.5s cubic-bezier(.77,0,.175,1)). On release the fill and text return at once over the same length. Use it to hide and then reveal ”what is happening in this scene” on slider photo slots and work cards.

options.--fx-fill: Rising fill color (via style), default var(--kf-bg)
options.--fx-lag: Gap before the text rises after the surface, default .03s (entering only)
options.is-fx-on: Add this class to an element for the on state — on devices without hover, apply it to the current cell of the slider strip

from.where: index.html .kv-slide (hero photo strip cell — white caption box over a sky-blue photo)
